Lemma
[Critical exponential estimate] 1. ch7:7.13\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0172, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0173 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0173 Let $1<p<\infty $, $f\in L^p(\Omega )$, and $g=V_{1/p}f$. There are $c_1,c_2>0$, depending only on $n,p$, such that \begin{equation} \tag {7.35} \int _\Omega \exp \! \left[\left(\frac{|g|}{c_1\| f\| _p}\right)^{p'}\right]dx \leq c_2|\Omega |, \qquad p'=\frac p{p-1}. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply (7.34) with arbitrary $q\geq p$ to bound the $q$th moments of $g$. Insert the resulting bounds into the exponential series. Stirling’s estimate makes the series converge once $c_1^{p'}>e\omega _np'$.

□
